subject_swap.rule: buildKit(layout, { subject: { pose, props } }) drops every kit item whose subjectSwap equals the subject's pose id or one of its prop asset ids (props as an array or a slot map); the dropped ids are in root.userData.dropped. Use it when the prompt subject brings its own ball (kick, throw, catch) so the kit ball does not double up.
